To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“Instagram posts can be used to characterize urban micro-events, and a novel approach to do so, EiM, can achieve spatial resolution that is less that 1% of the range of the macro-event, and temporal resolution that ranges from 10% to 30%, depending upon the event.”

(i) Instagram images can be used to characterize urban micro-events, (ii) semantic image annotations are a valuable resource, but need to be pre-processed to remove irrelevant images, and (iii) a clustering-based approach can be used to identify micro-events from the pre-processed data.

(a) image content is useful for identifying micro-events; (b) image content is not useful for identifying macro-events; (c) text captions are useful for identifying micro- and macro-events; (d) image content is more useful than text captions in the case of micro-events; (e) image content is less useful than text captions for macro-events.
